comment: * Callbacks for monitoring the attribute change.

methods.name: void onWidthChanged(int width)
methods.comment: Called when the width is changed

methods.name: void onHeightChanged(int height)
methods.comment: Called when the height is changed

methods.name: void onMarginChanged(@NonNull Insets margin)
methods.comment: Called when the margin is changed

methods.name: void onVisibilityChanged(boolean visible)
methods.comment: Called when the visibility is changed

methods.name: void onDrawableChanged(@NonNull Drawable drawable)
methods.comment: Called when the drawable is changed

methods.name: void onTranslationXChanged(float translationX)
methods.comment: Called when the translation along the x-axis is changed

methods.name: void onTranslationYChanged(float translationY)
methods.comment: Called when the translation along the y-axis is changed

methods.name: void onAlphaChanged(float alpha)
methods.comment: Called when the transparency is changed
